scope: Native software tests, all-role compilation and matching unflashed release exports
buildCommand: python -m platformio run -e companion -e relay -e hub
nativeTests: Loop identity ignores only mutable TTL
Largest frame indexed out-of-order BLE reassembly
Conflicting/short chunks rejected and partial state expires
Duplicate suppression permits an identical retry after six seconds
Default BLE companion-only with explicit hub opt-in
Canonical MAC suffix distinguishes common-prefix boards
Actual queued work takes priority over unlinked decoration
Hub accepted-RX age, age units and packet-notice expiry
RX clock and notice handle millis rollover
Relay scenes ignore unrelated phone state

display.graphics: Original monochrome envelope courier, with bounded two-frame walking feet for queued work
display.font: Pinned Adafruit GFX FreeSansBold9pt7b title and default 1x body
display.stateSource: Actual radio-ready flag, queued frame count, BLE connection+notification subscription and accepted nonsuppressed RX timestamp
display.receiveMeaning: Structurally accepted radio packet; content authentication remains at the phone/hub
display.refresh: At most once per second, skipped during TX or pending radio event, no animation delays

notes: No USB/BLE ports were opened, boards flashed or services restarted by this firmware update.
The v1 wire format, radio PHY, forwarding, retry/duplicate rules, queue limits and companion-only BLE defaults are preserved.
The character describes local transport state and never claims hub authentication, emergency-service dispatch or responder arrival.
The new release manifests preserve all four image offsets and hash five production source files including include/status_screen.h.
Physical OLED appearance, actual BLE operation and radio transfer need the controlled board flash and bench check. Earlier revision hardware evidence does not verify these images.
